name: Women's, Gender & Sexuality Studies
summary: Women's, Gender and Sexuality Studies examines how gender and sexuality shape individual lives, social institutions, and power. The major is interdisciplinary and draws on history, sociology, literature, and law.
description: This major explores how ideas about gender and sexuality are created and how they intersect with race, class, disability, and nationality. Coursework covers feminist and queer theory, the history of women's and LGBTQ+ movements, gender and work, reproductive health and rights, gender and law, masculinities, and representations of gender in literature, film, and media. Students learn to analyze social structures and cultural texts and often complete internships with advocacy groups, health organizations, or community agencies. Graduates work in advocacy, nonprofits, public health, human resources, education, law, and policy.
